newActionable.action: Compare historical P4.C2 raw and material versions at identical source-frame numbers, especially around frame 98 at 30 fps. Review the full give at normal speed, then the edge passage, release and return frame by frame; record which actual raw movement Jakob selects and for what property.

newActionable.boundary: A material BACK/EDGE/FRONT schedule is authored display, not proof of original physical side. Reuse tracks only when their source hash matches. No archive film was opened by this audit.

newActionable.action: Before a new requested P7 generation, use one consistent hand description: her anatomical left hand on viewer-right. Verify that the pictured starting grip can reach the intended palm-up release, and that the last image has the correct card count, next shoe card and ready pose. Do not simultaneously prescribe incompatible finger, card-axis and forearm rotations.
newActionable.whyNew: Concrete prompt ambiguity and anchor-grip preflight are not in the existing production recipe.
newActionable.boundary: Do not edit immutable historical prompts. A clearer prompt does not establish the cause of earlier failure. No new paid job is authorized by this receipt.

newActionable.action: If a new hard movement is separately commissioned, prepare one 12-second continuous take with trim room for release and empty return. Record every changed input. If the same clear ghost-card, wrong-side or large-target failure recurs, use a demonstrated physical movement or a different controlled production method rather than continuing text-only variants.
newActionable.whyNew: The proposed duration, phase budget and explicit method-change trigger are new production guidance.
newActionable.boundary: Duration is a candidate hypothesis, not measured superiority. A reference-video request is a separate variant whose current provider contract must be checked before use.

newActionable.action: Define acceptable landing error in the actual source resolution before acceptance. Report center displacement separately from corner/contour error. Require one continuously traceable card, exactly one additional table card, unchanged existing cards, credible release and empty return, plus a normal-speed seam check of body, gaze, shoe and hands.
newActionable.whyNew: Existing docs require correct landing/contact but do not define the measurement split or explicit table-card-count invariant.
newActionable.boundary: No numeric tolerance is invented here. A near-target magenta centroid cannot prove shape or hand contact.

newActionable.action: Use an asymmetrical, one-sided orientation marker only when blank-card corners and grip cannot establish orientation; it must exist in the actual anchors and raw take. Keep orientation UNKNOWN through complete occlusion unless continuity supports it. Check UV mirroring and stable corner ordering near edge-on frames before material acceptance.
newActionable.whyNew: The diagnostic marker and explicit UV/corner-order checks add precision beyond the existing color/side separation.
newActionable.boundary: Do not regenerate an otherwise useful white-card source merely to make it pink. A post-added marker does not prove the original turn. This is a possible diagnostic method, not a mandatory visual change.

newActionable.action: Define READY compatibility as body/hand pose plus explicit persistent table state. Record that a C2 source containing C1 depends on that C1 state; it cannot be freely reused across arbitrary table layouts until masking/composition is verified.
newActionable.whyNew: Existing docs request the same SHOE_READY but do not explicitly distinguish shared pose from identical whole-image state or enumerate baked-in C1 dependencies.
newActionable.boundary: No new runtime state engine or Scout change is proposed in this audit.

newActionable.action: At the next authorized review publication, present raw and material versions synchronized by source frame, anchors, prompt/settings, frozen plan, selected reference, observed events, decisions, commit and served manifest in one case. Include historical P4 media/anchors only when publication is explicitly in scope; verify anonymous playback and seeking against the same hash/status.

productionRecipe.timingEvidence: All proposed seconds above are requested phase budgets only. Actual TAKE, PASS, TURN interval, LAND, RELEASE and RETURN must be observed and stored as source-frame numbers; events may overlap.

Anatomical hand, traceable card orientation, start/end body pose and required existing-card state.
Final state with exactly one new card, unchanged prior cards, empty returning hand and next card ready in the fixed shoe.
Independent decisions for raw movement, mask/material, assembly and Scout connection.
